results.title: Cardiologists seek review of DGHS order banning re-use of single-use medical devices to reduce angioplasty costs
results.content: With an increasing proportion of the population requiring advanced cardiac interventions, making complex procedures affordable to ordinary patients has become a major challenge. Permitting the regulated re-use of select interventional devices, wherever scientifically proven safe, could help reduce treatment costs and extend the benefits of modern cardiac care to a wider section of the population, says Cardiological Society of India, Kerala chapter

results.content: PM Modi conveyed India’s readiness to contribute to all efforts aimed at peaceful resolution of the conflict.

results.title: At peak of air pollution on Deepavali night, data goes missing at several govt monitoring stations in Delhi
results.content: ‘When the hourly PM2.5 data is missing, it will artificially lower the Air Quality Index, showing better air quality, when the actual air quality is worse,’ Manoj Kumar, analyst, Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air said
